import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Check a local fixture.")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit the stable JSON result.")
    parser.add_argument("--fail", action="store_true", help="Simulate a contract failure.")
    parser.add_argument("--config", default="fixture.toml", help="Path to a local config file.")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.fail:
        print("E_CHECK: simulated check failure", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if not Path(args.config).is_file():
        print("Failed", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "checked": 3}, separators=(",", ":")))
        return 0
    print("Welcome to Fixture Check!")
    print("Fixture Check checks your fixture.")
    print("Checking 3 fixture files...")
    print("Checked 3 fixture files.")
    print("All checks passed.")
    print("Success! All checks passed.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
